title: 第二十六章 亡魂不是阵料
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
七块烧名骨牌同时亮起。

    沟底像被人撬开了一道缝，黑红煞气从泥里一股股往上冲。那些刚被沈清萝暂时护住的小鬼，全被往阵心拖。

    阿满的魂影被拉得最厉害。

    他是阵眼。

    沈清萝只看一眼就明白了。

    纸傀不是为了杀他们。

    是为了逼他们选。

    救阿满，其他小鬼可能被拖碎。

    救其他小鬼，阿满这个阵眼会先炸。

    谢无咎抬手，归墟煞气在他掌心聚起。

    “我封沟。”

    沈清萝猛地回头：“不行！”

    “阵再开下去，会牵更多无名魂。”

    “你封沟，他们也没了。”

    “他们已经死了！”

    这句话落下，沈清萝脸色也变了。

    她知道谢无咎不是恶意。幽冥渊那些煞物，哪个不是救不回才被丢进去的。对他，先封住更大的祸，是最熟的办法。

    可熟，不等于对。

    沈清萝往前一步。

    “死了也不是阵料。”

    谢无咎看她。

    “你救不了所有魂！”

    “我知道！”

    她声音很稳，稳得有点发硬。

    “但我现在只问眼前这几个！”

    燕不归在旁边冷声道：“你们吵完了吗？阵要塌了。”

    沈清萝：“没吵，在分工！”

    谢无咎：“她单方面命令。”

    沈清萝不理他，蹲下铺黄纸。

    “我要给他们临时归名。阿泥、阿满、阿七、阿桥、阿灯……先用能记住的名，把魂从阵里拽回来。”

    燕不归皱眉：“玄司没有这种规矩。”

    “那就今天先没有规矩地救。”

    “回去你会被问的！”

    “我天天被问！”

    沈清萝把黄纸压在骨牌边。

    “谢无咎，你只压边界，不准碰魂心。”

    谢无咎冷笑：“你教我用煞？”

    “不！”

    她抬眼看他。

    “我教你别乱用！”

    这话很欠揍。

    宋砚已经默默往后退了半步。

    谢无咎盯着她，脸色极冷。可下一刻，他还是把掌心归墟煞散开，只铺在沟边。

    “你最好撑得住。”

    沈清萝低头画符。

    “你少咒我。”

    第一张临名符落下，阿泥的哭声轻了一点。

    第二张，阿桥那团魂火从骨牌底下浮起来。

    第三张，阿灯的魂影闪了一下，像真的被人点了一盏小灯。

    铁柱在旁边飞快记。

    他手短，翻页却快。
content_en:
Seven famous dominoes light up at the same time.

The bottom of the ditch seemed to have been pried open, and black and red evil spirits rushed upward from the mud.Those little devils who had just been temporarily protected by Shen Qingluo were all dragged towards the center of the formation.

Aman's soul was pulled the hardest.

He is the eye of the formation.

Shen Qingluo understood it after just one glance.

Paper puppets are not meant to kill them.

It’s to force them to choose.

Save Aman, other brats may be dragged to pieces.

To save the other brats, Aman's formation will explode first.

Xie Wujiu raised his hand, and the evil spirit of Guixu gathered in his palm.

"I'll seal the ditch."

Shen Qingluo turned back sharply: "No!"

"If the formation continues, more nameless souls will be attracted."

"If you seal the ditch, they will be gone too."

"They're dead!"

After saying these words, Shen Qingluo's expression changed.

She knew Xie Wujiu didn't mean any harm.None of those evil creatures in Netherworld Abyss were thrown in because they couldn't be saved.For him, sealing off the bigger disaster first is the most familiar way.

Being familiar doesn't mean being right.

Shen Qingluo took a step forward.

"Even if you die, you won't be able to join the formation."

Xie Wujiu looked at her.

"You can't save all the souls!"

"I know!"

Her voice was steady, a little stiff.

"But now I only ask the few in front of me!"

Yan Bugui said coldly from the side: "Are you done arguing? The formation is about to collapse."

Shen Qingluo: "No quarrel, we are dividing the work!"

Xie Wujiu: "She gave the order unilaterally."

Shen Qingluo ignored him and squatted down to spread the yellow paper.

"I want to give them temporary names. A Ni, A Man, A Qi, A Qiao, A Deng... first use names that can be remembered to drag the souls back from the formation."

Yan Bugui frowned: "Xuansi doesn't have such rules."

"Then let's save him without any rules today."

"You will be asked when you go back!"

“I get asked every day!”

Shen Qingluo pressed the yellow paper next to the dominoes.

"Xie Wujiu, you only press the boundaries, don't touch the soul heart."

Xie Wujiu sneered: "You teach me how to use evil spirits?"

"No!"

She looked up at him.

"I'll teach you not to use it indiscriminately!"

These words deserve a beating.

Song Yan had silently taken half a step back.

Xie Wujiu stared at her with a very cold expression.But the next moment, he spread his palms over Gui Xu Sha and only spread them on the edge of the ditch.

"You better hold on."

Shen Qingluo lowered her head and drew the talisman.

"Stop cursing me."

The first name-promoting talisman fell, and Ah Ni's cry became softer.

In the second picture, Ah Qiao's soul fire floated up from under the dominoes.

In the third picture, A Deng's soul flashed, as if someone had really lit a small lamp.

Tie Zhu was writing quickly beside him.

His hands are short, but he turns pages quickly.
